title: How Zach Yadegari and the Cal AI founders built and sold a top iOS app
summary: Starter Story spends a day with the Cal AI founders in New York. Zach Yadegari explains why they went all in, how four friends with separate domains and deep trust made hard decisions, and why solving your own problem makes product and marketing click.

principles.text: Build for a problem you personally have; product design and marketing follow naturally.
principles.quote: if you're really solving your own problem, it really makes everything fall into place because you know exactly what you would want out of the product you're building.
